item.kubejs.crook.description: The Crook is a tool for harvesting leaves. It increases sapling drops and adds a chance to drop silkworms.
item.kubejs.crushing_hammer.description: The Crushing Hammer is used to smash blocks into other blocks and items. For example, it can crush cobblestone into gravel, gravel into sand, and sand into dust. It can also crush deepslate, netherrack, blackstone, and end stone into siftable versions.

tooltip.desolate_planet.crook_increases_: Can be used to break leaves to increase sapling drops and get silk worms.
